title: CheckReport
description: The Findings printed by `rulelink check --format json`. It shows that links exist between Rules and code, not that the code is correct. Later releases may add fields and Finding codes: ignore what you do not know.

findings.description: Errors first, then by code, Identifier, file and line.

Finding.description: One Finding. A field that does not apply is left out.

code.description: The code, such as `RL001`. Rely on `severity` and `message` for an unknown one.

file.description: The file at fault, from the project root and `/`-separated.

line.description: The line at fault in `file`, from 1.

message.description: One sentence saying what is wrong.

name.description: The name that sets the level of the Finding, such as `unknown-reference`.

rule.description: The Identifier the Finding is about.

severity.description: An error makes the check fail.

Totals.description: How many Findings are reported, by severity.
